notes: *of* at t004 belongs to the relative's own English rendering (*of which*); rule 44's supplied-preposition sentence does not reach it, because the tree is not the English verb's object — the כִּי-clause is.
`הִוא` is unrepresented: the written relative supplies the English subject of the participial clause, so the resumptive pronoun has nothing left to take (rules 20, 22).
`עֹשָׂה` keeps only *maketh* because מִלְחָמָה is written and takes *war*, so rule 44's light-verb head does not apply within that unit.
